narr: A pair of shortwave troughs generated two rounds of thunderstorms; one on May 11 and the other on May 12. Most storms occurred on Sunday as the second and stronger disturbance moved overhead. Some storms became severe producing hail up to golf ball sized, but flash flooding became the main impact with the later round of storms on May 12th, especially in Central Texas.
ev: A trained spotter reported a flooded low water crossing in Groesbeck at Yeagua and Railroad. Additional flooding was reported east of Groesbeck near LCR 420 and 421 where the road was impassable.
Emergency management reported heavy ponding on Hwy 121 between Trenton and Westminster with multiple accidents occurring. Additional flooding was reported on the roadway at Highway 121 and 82.
Emergency management reported flooding over the roadway on Emberson Chapel Rd southeast of Tioga.
A trained spotter reported flooding on North Carpenter between Prospect and Texas Avenue as well as flooded roadways throughout Mart.

Emergency management reported that FM 80, south of Interstate 45, was closed due to flooding and remained closed one day later. Multiple CRs were also closed due to flooding during the heavy rain event.
A trained spotter reported multiple roadways flooded. LCR 751 in the southwest part of the county was impassable due to flood waters.
Emergency management reported the Interstate 45 service road near mile marker 168 was closed due to floodwaters.
Emergency management reported multiple county roads closed between Jewett and Marquez due to flooding.
Emergency management reported that several water rescues were performed in Leon Co including one on FM 542 south of Oakwood.
A trained spotter reported flooded and impassable low water crossings near Plummers Creek and LCR 456 north of Groesbeck.
Emergency management reported flooding on the I-35 service road south of Valley View with a vehicle water rescue.
Emergency management reported an Amazon driver stalled out due to Range Creek overflowing its banks, around the 700th block of Horseshoe Road between Tioga and Collinsville.
